3750.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — kubernetes-el Compromised: How a Pwn Request Exploited a Popular Emacs Package
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("funny.sh", "memdump.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/tmp/secrets") or FileName in~ ("funny.sh", "memdump.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3750.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — kubernetes-el Compromised: How a Pwn Request Exploited a Popular Emacs Package ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("funny.sh","memdump.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/secrets*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("funny.sh","memdump.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

description: Detects file write or download of openclawcore-1.0.3.zip, the password-protected ZIP (password 'openclaw') delivered to Windows users by the malicious google-qx4 / NET_NiNjA ClawHub skills (Snyk, Feb 2026).
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/clawhub-malicious-google-skill-openclaw-malware/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/02/10
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.t1204.002
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_filename:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\openclawcore-1.0.3.zip'
      - '\openclawcore.zip'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\openclawcore'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.zip'
  condition: selection_filename or selection_path
falsepositives:
  - Threat intel team intentionally pulling the sample for analysis.
level: high

3796.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\openclawcore-1.0.3.zip OR *\\openclawcore*.zip OR *\\OPENCLAWCORE*.ZIP)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @CommandLine:(*github.com/denboss99/openclaw-core* OR *openclawcore-1.0.3.zip* OR *aztr0nutz/NET_NINJA*)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @CommandLine:(*denboss99/openclaw-core* OR *openclawcore-1.0.3.zip* OR *aztr0nutz/NET_NINJA*))
3796.falcon:
(#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/openclawcore[-_].*\.zip$/i)
OR (#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (regex("github\\.com/denboss99/openclaw-core", field=CommandLine) OR regex("openclawcore-1\\.0\\.3\\.zip", field=CommandLine) OR regex("aztr0nutz/NET_NINJA", field=CommandLine)))

      - '/npm'

title: Sha1-Hulud npm Worm Payload Artefacts (setup_bun.js / bun_environment.js / discussion.yaml)
id: e9f1a0b4-6c52-4e8d-9a17-d3b8c4f0e5a2
description: Detects creation of the Sha1-Hulud "Second Coming" npm worm artefacts setup_bun.js, bun_environment.js, or .github/workflows/discussion.yaml by a Node.js / npm / yarn / pnpm / bun / shell process during a preinstall script. The two JS files bootstrap and execute the worm's payload; the YAML workflow is the Discussion-event-triggered backdoor that runs on the registered SHA1HULUD self-hosted runner.
references:
    - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/how-harden-runner-detected-the-sha1-hulud-supply-chain-attack-in-cncfs-backstage-repository
    - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/npm-supply-chain-attack/
    - https://semgrep.dev/blog/2025/digging-for-secrets-sha1-hulud-the-second-coming-of-the-npm-worm/
    - https://securitylabs.datadoghq.com/articles/shai-hulud-2.0-npm-worm/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/13
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1195.002
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.007
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1546
logsource:
    category: file_event
detection:
    selection_filename:
        TargetFilename|endswith:
            - '\setup_bun.js'
            - '/setup_bun.js'
            - '\bun_environment.js'
            - '/bun_environment.js'
    selection_workflow:
        TargetFilename|contains:
            - '\.github\workflows\discussion.yaml'
            - '/.github/workflows/discussion.yaml'
    selection_writer:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\node.exe'
            - '\npm.exe'
            - '\yarn.exe'
            - '\pnpm.exe'
            - '\bun.exe'
            - '\bash.exe'
            - '\sh.exe'
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '/node'
            - '/npm'
            - '/yarn'
            - '/pnpm'
            - '/bun'
            - '/bash'
            - '/sh'
    condition: (selection_filename or selection_workflow) and selection_writer
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate projects that genuinely use Bun and ship a setup_bun.js bootstrap script
    - Repositories that legitimately maintain a .github/workflows/discussion.yaml workflow (rare)
level: high
3838.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.process_name) as process_name values(Filesystem.process_path) as process_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("setup_bun.js","bun_environment.js") OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.github\\workflows\\discussion.yaml" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.github/workflows/discussion.yaml") AND Filesystem.process_name IN ("node.exe","node","npm.exe","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","bun.exe","bun","bash","sh","cmd.exe","powershell.exe") by host Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
3838.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\setup_bun.js OR *\\bun_environment.js OR *\\.github\\workflows\\discussion.yaml OR */setup_bun.js OR */bun_environment.js OR */.github/workflows/discussion.yaml) @Image:(*\\node.exe OR *\\npm.exe OR *\\yarn.exe OR *\\pnpm.exe OR *\\bun.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\bash.exe OR *\\sh.exe)) OR (source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:(PATH OR CREATE) @file.path:(*/setup_bun.js OR */bun_environment.js OR */.github/workflows/discussion.yaml) @process.name:(node OR npm OR yarn OR pnpm OR bun OR bash OR sh))

3839.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Sha1-Hulud: The Second Coming - Zapier, ENS Domains, and Other Prominent NPM Pac
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("bun_environment.js", "setup_bun.js", "bun.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/usr/src/app", "/root/.bun/bin/bun") or FileName in~ ("bun_environment.js", "setup_bun.js", "bun.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3839.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Sha1-Hulud: The Second Coming - Zapier, ENS Domains, and Other Prominent NPM Pac ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("bun_environment.js","setup_bun.js","bun.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/usr/src/app*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/root/.bun/bin/bun*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("bun_environment.js","setup_bun.js","bun.sh"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3840.def:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("bun.sh/install", "bun.sh/install.ps1")
| where FileName in~ ("curl.exe","curl","bash","sh","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","node","npm.exe","npm","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","bun.exe","bun")
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup_bun.js","preinstall")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildName  = FileName,
          ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
3840.sent:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("bun.sh/install", "bun.sh/install.ps1")
| where ActingProcessName matches regex @"(?i)(^|[\\/])(curl|bash|sh|powershell|pwsh|cmd)(\.exe)?$"
| where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)(^|[\\/])(node|npm|yarn|pnpm|bun)(\.exe|-cli\.js)?$"
   or ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup_bun.js","preinstall")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
3840.sigma:
title: NPM preinstall hook fetching Bun installer (Sha1-Hulud dropper)
id: 6c4b7e2a-1f9d-4a8c-9c1b-2a7e3d5b4f01
description: Detects the Sha1-Hulud Second Coming worm dropper where an npm/node/yarn/pnpm parent spawns curl, bash, sh, powershell or cmd with a bun.sh/install URL in the command line.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/sha1-hulud-the-second-coming-zapier-ens-domains-and-other-prominent-npm-packages-compromised
  - https://www.wiz.io/blog/shai-hulud-2-0-ongoing-supply-chain-attack
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2025/12/09/shai-hulud-2-0-guidance-for-detecting-investigating-and-defending-against-the-supply-chain-attack/
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1105
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent_pkg_manager:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '/node'
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\npm.cmd'
      - '/npm'
      - '\yarn.exe'
      - '/yarn'
      - '\pnpm.exe'
      - '/pnpm'
      - '\bun.exe'
      - '/bun'
  child_shell:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '/curl'
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  installer_url:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'bun.sh/install'
  condition: parent_pkg_manager and child_shell and installer_url
level: high
3840.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count, values(Processes.process) as cmdline, values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_name, values(Processes.process_name) as child_name, values(Processes.user) as user, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*bun.sh/install*" OR Processes.process="*irm bun.sh*iex*") by Processes.dest, Processes.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(parent_name,"(?i)^(node|npm|yarn|pnpm|bun)(\.exe|-cli\.js)?$") AND match(child_name,"(?i)^(curl|bash|sh|powershell|pwsh|cmd)(\.exe)?$")
| convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime)
3840.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\node.exe OR *\\Node.exe OR *\\NODE.EXE OR *\\npm.cmd OR *\\NPM.CMD OR *\\yarn.cmd OR *\\YARN.CMD OR *\\pnpm.cmd OR *\\PNPM.CMD OR *\\bun.exe OR *\\Bun.exe) @CommandLine:(*bun.sh/install* OR *bun.sh/install.ps1*)) OR (source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.parent.name:(node OR npm OR yarn OR pnpm OR bun) @process.command_line:*bun.sh/install*)
3840.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(node|npm|yarn|pnpm|bun)(\.exe|-cli\.js)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/[\\\/](curl|bash|sh|powershell|pwsh|cmd)(\.exe)?$/i
| CommandLine=/bun\.sh\/install(\.ps1)?/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

3841.def:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup_bun.js","bun_environment.js")
| where FileName in~ ("node.exe","node","bun.exe","bun")

ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup_bun.js","bun_environment.js")
| where ActingProcessName matches regex @"(?i)(^|[\\/])(node|bun)(\.exe)?$"
| extend HasBgMarker = ActingProcessCommandLine has "POSTINSTALL_BG"

| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          HasBgMarker, SHA256
3841.sigma:
title: Sha1-Hulud worm payload execution (setup_bun.js / bun_environment.js)
id: 7e3a8f1d-c2b5-4e6a-8d3f-1b9c4e7a2f02
description: Detects execution of the Sha1-Hulud The Second Coming worm's named JavaScript artefacts (setup_bun.js Stage 1 dropper, bun_environment.js Stage 2 10MB+ obfuscated payload) by node or bun runtimes.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/sha1-hulud-the-second-coming-zapier-ens-domains-and-other-prominent-npm-packages-compromised
  - https://www.wiz.io/blog/shai-hulud-2-0-ongoing-supply-chain-attack
  - https://orca.security/resources/blog/shai-hulud-npm-malware-wave-2/
  - https://www.elastic.co/blog/shai-hulud-worm-2-0-updated-response
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1027
  - attack.t1195.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  runtime:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '/node'
      - '\bun.exe'
      - '/bun'
  worm_script:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'setup_bun.js'
      - 'bun_environment.js'
  condition: runtime and worm_script
level: critical
3841.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count, values(Processes.process) as cmdline, values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_name, values(Processes.process_name) as proc_name, values(Processes.user) as user, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*setup_bun.js*" OR Processes.process="*bun_environment.js*") by Processes.dest, Processes.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(proc_name,"(?i)^(node|bun)(\.exe)?$")
| convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime)
3841.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\node.exe OR *\\Node.exe OR *\\NODE.EXE OR *\\bun.exe OR *\\Bun.exe OR *\\BUN.EXE) @CommandLine:(*setup_bun.js* OR *bun_environment.js*)) OR (source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.name:(node OR bun) @process.command_line:(*setup_bun.js* OR *bun_environment.js*))
3841.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/[\\\/](node|bun)(\.exe)?$/i
| CommandLine=/(setup_bun|bun_environment)\.js/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())

3842.def:
let RunnerArchiveWrite = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)^actions-runner-(linux|osx|win)-[a-z0-9]+-[\d\.]+\.(tar\.gz|zip)$"
    | where FolderPath has ".dev-env"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              Source = "runner_archive_write",
              Detail = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName),
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let RunnerProcess = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where (FileName has_any ("Runner.Listener","config.sh","config.cmd","run.sh","run.cmd")
             or InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("Runner.Listener","config.sh","run.sh"))
      and (ProcessCommandLine has "SHA1HULUD" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "SHA1HULUD")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Source = "runner_sha1hulud_exec",
              Detail = ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
union RunnerArchiveWrite, RunnerProcess
| order by Timestamp desc
3842.sent:
let RunnerArchive = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)^actions-runner-(linux|osx|win)-[a-z0-9]+-[\d\.]+\.(tar\.gz|zip)$"
    | where TargetFilePath has ".dev-env"
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              Source = "runner_archive_write",
              Detail = TargetFilePath,
              ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
let RunnerProc = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where (ActingProcessName has_any ("Runner.Listener","config.sh","config.cmd","run.sh","run.cmd")
             or ParentProcessName has_any ("Runner.Listener","config.sh","run.sh"))
      and (ActingProcessCommandLine has "SHA1HULUD" or ParentProcessCommandLine has "SHA1HULUD")
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              Source = "runner_sha1hulud_exec",
              Detail = ActingProcessCommandLine,
              ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
union RunnerArchive, RunnerProc
| order by TimeGenerated desc
3842.sigma:
title: Sha1-Hulud SHA1HULUD self-hosted GitHub Actions runner registration
id: 9b1d4e7f-3a8c-4b2d-9e6f-5c8a1b4d3e03
description: Detects the Sha1-Hulud Second Coming worm registering a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner with the literal name 'SHA1HULUD' via Runner.Listener or the config.sh helper.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/sha1-hulud-the-second-coming-zapier-ens-domains-and-other-prominent-npm-packages-compromised
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2025/12/09/shai-hulud-2-0-guidance-for-detecting-investigating-and-defending-against-the-supply-chain-attack/
  - https://www.wiz.io/blog/shai-hulud-2-0-ongoing-supply-chain-attack
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.t1543
  - attack.t1546
  - attack.t1554
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  runner_binary:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\Runner.Listener.exe'
      - '/Runner.Listener'
      - '/config.sh'
      - '\config.cmd'
      - '/run.sh'
      - '\run.cmd'
  sha1hulud_name:
    CommandLine|contains: 'SHA1HULUD'
  condition: runner_binary and sha1hulud_name
level: critical
3842.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count, values(_time) as times, values(Filesystem.file_path) as path, values(Filesystem.process_name) as proc_name, values(Filesystem.user) as user, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="actions-runner-linux-x64-*.tar.gz" OR Filesystem.file_name="actions-runner-osx-*.tar.gz" OR Filesystem.file_name="actions-runner-win-*.zip") AND Filesystem.file_path="*/.dev-env/*" by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| append
  [| tstats summariesonly=t count, values(Processes.process) as cmdline, values(Processes.process_name) as proc_name, values(Processes.user) as user, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process="*SHA1HULUD*" AND (Processes.process="*Runner.Listener*" OR Processes.process="*config.sh*" OR Processes.process="*--name*SHA1HULUD*") by Processes.dest, Processes.user
  | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`]
| convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime)
3842.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:(1 OR 11) (@Image:(*\\Runner.Listener.exe OR *\\runner.listener.exe OR *\\config.cmd OR *\\Config.cmd OR *\\run.cmd) AND @CommandLine:*SHA1HULUD*)) OR (source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.name:(Runner.Listener OR config.sh OR run.sh) @process.command_line:*SHA1HULUD*) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\.dev-env\\actions-runner-* OR */.dev-env/actions-runner-*))
3842.falcon:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/[\\\/](Runner\.Listener(\.exe)?|config\.(sh|cmd)|run\.(sh|cmd))$/i CommandLine=/SHA1HULUD/) OR (#event_simpleName=FileWritten regex("actions-runner-(linux|osx|win)-[a-z0-9]+-[0-9.]+\\.(tar\\.gz|zip)$", field=TargetFileName) regex("[\\\/]\\.dev-env[\\\/]", field=TargetFileName))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, #event_simpleName, ImageFileName, TargetFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

3843.def:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("bun.exe","bun","node.exe","node")
| where RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)(secretsmanager\.[a-z0-9-]+\.amazonaws\.com|secretmanager\.googleapis\.com|[a-z0-9-]+\.vault\.azure\.net)"
| extend Cloud = case(
    RemoteUrl has "secretsmanager.", "AWS",
    RemoteUrl has "secretmanager.googleapis.com", "GCP",
    RemoteUrl has ".vault.azure.net", "Azure",
    "other")
| summarize Endpoints = make_set(RemoteUrl, 50),
            Clouds   = make_set(Cloud, 5),
            HitCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
               InitiatingProcessFileName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where array_length(Clouds) >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
3843.sent:
ImDnsActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where DnsQuery matches regex @"(?i)(secretsmanager\.[a-z0-9-]+\.amazonaws\.com|secretmanager\.googleapis\.com|[a-z0-9-]+\.vault\.azure\.net)"
| extend Cloud = case(
    DnsQuery has "secretsmanager.", "AWS",
    DnsQuery has "secretmanager.googleapis.com", "GCP",
    DnsQuery has ".vault.azure.net", "Azure",
    "other")
| summarize Endpoints = make_set(DnsQuery, 50),
            Clouds   = make_set(Cloud, 5),
            HitCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
            by SrcIpAddr, SrcHostname, SrcUsername, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where array_length(Clouds) >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
3843.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count, dc(All_Traffic.dest) as dest_count, values(All_Traffic.dest) as endpoints, values(All_Traffic.process_name) as proc_name, values(All_Traffic.user) as user, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest="*.secretsmanager.*.amazonaws.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="secretmanager.googleapis.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.vault.azure.net") AND (All_Traffic.process_name="bun.exe" OR All_Traffic.process_name="bun" OR All_Traffic.process_name="node.exe" OR All_Traffic.process_name="node") by All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.user, span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| eval cloud_providers=mvfilter(match(endpoints,"secretsmanager|secretmanager.googleapis.com|vault.azure.net"))
| eval aws_hit=if(match(mvjoin(endpoints,","),"secretsmanager"),1,0)
| eval gcp_hit=if(match(mvjoin(endpoints,","),"secretmanager.googleapis.com"),1,0)
| eval azure_hit=if(match(mvjoin(endpoints,","),"vault.azure.net"),1,0)
| eval cloud_count=aws_hit+gcp_hit+azure_hit
| where cloud_count >= 2
| convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime)
3843.datadog: (source:cloudtrail @evt.name:(ListSecrets OR GetSecretValue OR DescribeSecret OR BatchGetSecretValue) @userIdentity.type:(AssumedRole OR IAMUser) @evt.outcome:success) OR (source:azure.activity_logs @operationName.value:(Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/secrets/read OR Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/secrets/list/action OR Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/secrets/getSecret/action)) OR (source:gcp.audit @protoPayload.methodName:(google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretManagerService.AccessSecretVersion OR google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretManagerService.ListSecrets))

3844.def:
let Lookback = 24h;
let Infection = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("bun_environment.js","setup_bun.js")
    | summarize InfectionTime = min(Timestamp) by DeviceName;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("bun.exe","bun","node.exe","node")
| where RemoteUrl has "api.github.com"
| join kind=inner Infection on DeviceName
| where Timestamp between (InfectionTime .. InfectionTime + 1h)
| summarize ApiHits = count(),
            FirstHit = min(Timestamp),
            LastHit  = max(Timestamp),
            Endpoints = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25)
            by DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
               InitiatingProcessFileName, InfectionTime
| where ApiHits >= 5
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FirstHit, InfectionTime)
| project DeviceName, AccountName, InfectionTime, FirstHit, LastHit, DelaySec, ApiHits, InitiatingProcessFileName, Endpoints
| order by FirstHit desc
3844.sent:
let Lookback = 24h;
let Infection = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("bun_environment.js","setup_bun.js")
    | summarize InfectionTime = min(TimeGenerated) by DvcHostname;
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where DstHostname =~ "api.github.com" or Url has "api.github.com"

references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/plushdaemon-compromises-network-devices-for-adversary-in-the-middle-attacks/
  - https://github.com/eset/malware-ioc/tree/master/PlushDaemon
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03

  - attack.t1105

logsource:

    cs-uri|contains:
      - '/update/updateInfo.bzp'
      - '/update/file6.bdat'
      - '/update/file2.bdat'
      - 'popup_4.2.0.2246.dll'
  selection_query_combo:

falsepositives:

level: high

| where FileName =~ "python.exe"

// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named

| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,

| order by Timestamp desc

3916.sent:
// Hunt CVE-2025-29927 exploitation: external clients sending the bypass header to self-hosted Next.js apps.
// Header lives in WAF / reverse-proxy event text. AppServiceHTTPLogs does not surface arbitrary request
// headers, so we cover WAF (CommonSecurityLog) + raw nginx/IIS via Syslog/W3CIISLog where ingested.
let Window = 7d;
// Path 1 — WAF / reverse-proxy events that log full request headers/context
let WafHits = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where (RequestContext has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (Message has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString1 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString2 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString3 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString4 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString5 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString6 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, SourceUserName, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct,
              DestinationHostName, RequestURL, RequestMethod, RequestClientApplication,
              Evidence = coalesce(RequestContext, Message, DeviceCustomString1, DeviceCustomString2, DeviceCustomString3, DeviceCustomString4, DeviceCustomString5, DeviceCustomString6),
              Layer = "WAF";
// Path 2 — raw nginx / Apache access logs forwarded via Syslog (some teams strip headers, some don't)
let SyslogHits = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where SyslogMessage has "x-middleware-subrequest"
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP = HostIP, SourceUserName = "", DeviceVendor = "linux", DeviceProduct = Facility,
              DestinationHostName = HostName, RequestURL = "", RequestMethod = "", RequestClientApplication = "",
              Evidence = SyslogMessage, Layer = "Syslog";
// Path 3 — IIS reverse-proxy in front of Next.js (header value sometimes ends up in csUriQuery via URL Rewrite Module)
let IISHits = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where csUriQuery has "x-middleware-subrequest" or csReferer has "x-middleware-subrequest"
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP = cIP, SourceUserName = csUserName, DeviceVendor = "iis", DeviceProduct = "W3CIISLog",
              DestinationHostName = Computer, RequestURL = strcat(csUriStem, "?", csUriQuery), RequestMethod = csMethod,
              RequestClientApplication = csUserAgent,
              Evidence = strcat(csUriQuery, " | ", csReferer), Layer = "IIS";
union isfuzzy=true WafHits, SyslogHits, IISHits
| extend SourceIP = tostring(SourceIP)
| summarize Hits = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleEvidence = any(Evidence), Hosts = make_set(DestinationHostName, 25),
            URLs = make_set(RequestURL, 25), UAs = make_set(RequestClientApplication, 10),
            Layers = make_set(Layer, 5)
    by SourceIP
| order by FirstSeen asc

  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)

  | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessId=tostring(ProcessId), ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;

  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where FolderPath startswith "/proc/" and FileName in~ ("mem","maps")
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName matches regex @"^python[23]?$"
  | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, FolderPath, FileName, InitiatingProcessId=tostring(InitiatingProcessId), InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
MemReads
| join kind=inner (PythonProcs) on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.ProcessId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath, FileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine1
| order by Timestamp desc

3975.def:
let WindowMin = 10m;
let RestartThreshold = 3;   // empirical: legit reload is 1-2 spawns; a flood-induced crash loop spikes to >=3 inside 10 min
let HTTP2Servers = dynamic(["httpd","httpd.exe","nginx","nginx.exe","node","node.exe","java","java.exe","envoy","envoy.exe","traffic_server","traffic_manager"]);
let Exposed = DeviceInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, IsInternetFacing, PublicIP) by DeviceId, DeviceName
    | where IsInternetFacing == true;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where FileName in~ (HTTP2Servers)
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalina", "org.apache.catalina", "tomcat", "trafficserver")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
   and InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("apt", "apt-get", "yum", "dnf", "rpm", "dpkg", "systemctl", "service", "docker", "containerd-shim", "podman", "kubelet", "ansible", "chef-client", "puppet", "saltstack")
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine !has "reload" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine !has "graceful" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine !has "--test"
| summarize Restarts = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, FileName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where Restarts >= RestartThreshold
| extend SpanSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| join kind=inner Exposed on DeviceId
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, SpanSec, Restarts, DeviceName, PublicIP, FileName, Parents, SampleCmd
| order by Restarts desc

let WindowMin = 10m;

let HTTP2ServersWin = dynamic(["httpd.exe","nginx.exe","node.exe","java.exe","envoy.exe","traffic_server.exe","traffic_manager.exe"]);
let HTTP2ServersNix = dynamic(["httpd","nginx","node","java","envoy","traffic_server","traffic_manager"]);

(

    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)

    | extend Image = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | where Image in~ (HTTP2ServersWin)
       or CommandLine has_any ("catalina", "tomcat", "org.apache.catalina")
    | where CommandLine !has "reload" and CommandLine !has "graceful" and CommandLine !has "--test"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
),
(
    ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | extend Image = tostring(split(ActingProcessName, "/")[-1])
    | where Image in~ (HTTP2ServersNix)
       or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalina", "tomcat", "trafficserver")

            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),

            SampleCmd = any(CommandLine),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5)

| order by Restarts desc

// Article: backdoor activates when sshd (via libsystemd) loads the malicious liblzma.so.5.6.0 / 5.6.1.

    or FileName endswith "liblzma.so.5.6.1"
    or FolderPath has_any ("liblzma.so.5.6.0", "liblzma.so.5.6.1")

    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, OSDistribution, PublicIP, IsInternetFacing) by DeviceId

3977.sent:
// Article: backdoor activates when sshd chain-loads liblzma.so.5.6.0 / 5.6.1 via libsystemd.
// Path A: Defender XDR Linux EDR image-load telemetry forwarded to Sentinel.
// Path B: auditd PATH records via Syslog connector when DeviceImageLoadEvents is unavailable.
let edr = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ActingProcessName has "sshd" or ActingProcessName has "systemd"
    | where TargetFileName has_any ("liblzma.so.5.6.0", "liblzma.so.5.6.1")
    | project TimeGenerated, Source="ImFileEvent", Host=DvcHostname, Process=ActingProcessName, Cmd=ActingProcessCommandLine, File=TargetFilePath;
let aud = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Facility in ("auth","authpriv","daemon","user")
    | where ProcessName in~ ("audisp-syslog","audispd","sshd","systemd","auditd")
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("liblzma.so.5.6.0", "liblzma.so.5.6.1")
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("sshd", "systemd")
    | project TimeGenerated, Source="Syslog", Host=HostName, Process=ProcessName, Cmd="", File=SyslogMessage;
union edr, aud
| order by TimeGenerated desc

  - https://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2024/03/29/4
  - https://www.sysdig.com/blog/cve-2024-3094-detecting-the-sshd-backdoor-in-xz-utils
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-3094
author: SOC Detection Engineering

  - attack.t1554
  - attack.t1195.002

  category: file_event

    Image|endswith:
      - '/sshd'
      - '/systemd'
  selection_lib:

      - '/liblzma.so.5.6.0'

// IIS / App Service / WAF tier — Struts is typically fronted by IIS or an Azure App Service / WAF.
let TraversalRegex = @"(?i)(upload|file)FileName=(\.{2}(\/|%2f|\\|%5c))";
(union isfuzzy=true
    (W3CIISLog
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where csUriStem endswith ".action"
        | where csUriQuery matches regex TraversalRegex
        | project TimeGenerated, Computer, sSiteName, csMethod, csUriStem, csUriQuery, cIP, csUserAgent, scStatus, _ResourceId),
    (AppServiceHTTPLogs
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where CsUriStem endswith ".action"
        | where (CsUriQuery matches regex TraversalRegex) or (Cookie matches regex TraversalRegex)
        | project TimeGenerated, CsHost, CsMethod, CsUriStem, CsUriQuery, CIp, UserAgent, ScStatus, _ResourceId),
    (CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where DeviceProduct in~ ("WAF","ModSecurity","Imperva SecureSphere","F5 ASM","Azure WAF","Cloudflare")
        | where RequestURL has ".action"
        | where RequestURL matches regex TraversalRegex or Message matches regex TraversalRegex
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, SourceIP, DestinationIP, RequestURL, RequestMethod, RequestClientApplication, _ResourceId))
| order by TimeGenerated desc
